title: Raku Firing & Potluck Party
source_quote: Start Time:2026-11-12 Thursday Nov 12 2026 5:00-8:00PM Raku Firing & Potluck Party Raku firing provides instant gratification for the artist! Glazed ceramic pieces are taken out of the raku kiln, glowing red at around 1850 degrees Fahrenheit.
evidence_sentence: The events page lists a Raku Firing & Potluck Party on November 12, 2026, as a public event.
evidence_quote: Raku firing provides instant gratification for the artist! Glazed ceramic pieces are taken out of the raku kiln, glowing red at around 1850 degrees Fahrenheit.
summary: A public raku firing and potluck gathering on November 12, 2026 at Steamboat Creates, where potters can fire glazed pieces in a raku kiln.
